tool_name: CSS Box Shadow & Layer Glow Generator
description: Generate smooth multi-layered CSS box-shadows, soft blurs, and neon glows with interactive visual controls.
faq_items: Can I adjust blur and spread?:::Yes, interactive sliders control X/Y offsets, blur radius, and spread distance in real time.|||Does it output standard CSS?:::Outputs clean, cross-browser CSS box-shadow declarations ready to copy into your stylesheet.|||Is it mobile friendly?:::Yes, preview scales seamlessly on desktop and mobile screens.
related_tools: Tailwind CSS Color Palette Generator,CSS Minifier,Aspect Ratio Calculator

description: Parse complex URLs into protocol, hostname, port, pathname, search query parameters, and hash fragments instantly.
faq_items: What parts of the URL are extracted?:::Extracts protocol, domain host, port, path, query parameters (as key-value pairs), and hash fragments.|||Can it handle URL encoded queries?:::Yes, automatically decodes URI percent-encoding in query parameters.|||Is sensitive query data kept private?:::Zero server communication—parsed purely in client browser memory.
related_tools: URL Encoder and Decoder,cURL to JavaScript Fetch Converter,JWT Decoder and Debugger

tool_name: Hex to RGB and HSL Color Converter
description: Convert Hex color codes to RGB, RGBA, and HSL formats instantly with live visual color previews and 1-click copying.
faq_items: Does it support 3-digit shorthand Hex?:::Yes, shorthand hex codes like #fff or #09f are automatically expanded to 6 digits.|||Can I copy CSS formatted values?:::Yes, 1-click buttons copy ready-to-use rgb(), rgba(), and hsl() CSS functions.|||Is a color picker included?:::Yes, you can click the color picker swatch to visually choose colors or type raw hex codes.
related_tools: Tailwind CSS Color Palette Generator,Color Contrast Checker,CSS Minifier

description: Convert comma-separated values (CSV) and spreadsheet rows into clean GitHub-flavored Markdown tables instantly.
faq_items: Does it handle quotes in CSV cells?:::Yes, properly handles escaped commas and quoted cells.|||Are columns aligned automatically?:::Yes, column counts are normalized and formatted with standard Markdown pipes and separators.|||Is it browser-side?:::Zero server upload—your CSV data never leaves your browser.
related_tools: Markdown Table to JSON Array Converter,CSV to JSON Converter,Markdown Live Previewer

description: Compress and minify JSON data by stripping whitespace, newlines, and indentation to reduce payload transfer size.
faq_items: How much file size does it save?:::Typically saves 20% to 40% of payload size by removing whitespace and formatting characters.|||Does it validate JSON syntax?:::Yes, invalid JSON syntax is highlighted with clear error messages before minification.|||Can I copy with 1 click?:::Yes, single-click copy button copies the compact one-line string to your clipboard.
related_tools: JSON Formatter,JSON to YAML Data Converter,JSON to CSV Converter

description: Generate clean, SEO-friendly URL slugs from blog titles, headlines, and strings with customizable separators and accents.
faq_items: Does it remove special characters?:::Yes, removes punctuation, symbols, and non-alphanumeric characters while preserving words.|||Does it handle accents and umlauts?:::Yes, normalizes unicode accents (e.g. é becomes e, ü becomes u).|||Can I choose separators?:::Supports both hyphens (-) and underscores (_) with optional lowercase enforcement.
related_tools: URL Parser & Query Parameter Extractor,Case Converter,Word Counter

tool_name: IPv4 CIDR Subnet & IP Range Calculator
description: Calculate subnet masks, usable host IP ranges, broadcast IPs, and wildcard masks for IPv4 CIDR blocks (/8 to /32).
faq_items: What does CIDR notation mean?:::Classless Inter-Domain Routing specifies the prefix length (bits in the network mask).|||How many usable hosts are in a /24 subnet?:::A /24 subnet provides 256 total IP addresses and 254 usable host addresses.|||Does it calculate broadcast and network IPs?:::Yes, network IP, broadcast IP, and first/last usable IP addresses are calculated instantly.
related_tools: DNS Record Lookup,Unix Timestamp Converter,Hash Generator
